title: Valid Country Codes
applicability: Applies to Segment 111 Table ID 59, which identifies the country in which the acquiring institution resides.

businessRequirements.title: A country reference in Table ID 59 shall use a valid three-digit country code from the Appendix AC list.
The Table ID 59 country code shall identify the country in which the acquiring institution resides, consistent with the merchant/acquirer configuration.

testCases.positive: Three-digit code present in the Appendix AC list, e.g. 840 (United States)
negative: code not present in the Appendix AC list

testCases.positive: Country code matches configured acquirer country
negative: Country code conflicts with configured acquirer country
